paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on Llama3.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of various methods across a range of co-occurrence numbers. The x-axis, labeled ‘Co-occurrence Number’, spans from 1.0 to 10<sup>10</sup>, using a logarithmic scale with tick intervals of powers of ten, starting at 1.0 and incrementing by 10 each interval. The y-axis, labeled ‘ACC (%)’, ranges from 60% to 80%, with tick intervals of 5%. A solid black line represents the Base method, beginning at approximately 65% and gradually increasing to approximately 72%. A solid brown line depicts the FT method, starting at roughly 63% and reaching approximately 70%. A dashed teal line represents the MEMIT method, initiating at approximately 65% and ultimately reaching around 73%. A solid red line shows the IKE method, beginning at approximately 64% and trending towards approximately 68%. Finally, a solid green line displays the ROME method, starting at approximately 64% and ending around 74%.
